high.label: Consequential
high.record: Approval record, exact proposed effect and result

critical.label: Destructive or canonical
critical.record: Approval, backup/reference, result and recovery information

alwaysRequireApproval: Purchases, payments, subscriptions, bookings or financial commitments
Sending messages, emails or publishing content
Medical instruction changes or any action presented as diagnosis or treatment
Creating, merging, renaming or deleting a Project World
Changing established canon or replacing a final approved decision
Writing to or publishing through GitHub
Enabling a new external integration that can read or write private data
invariants: No external action may be displayed as successful until the responsible provider confirms success.
No permission, connection or data access may be inferred from the presence of a path, URL or account name.
Silence, inactivity, opening a dialog or accepting a different action never counts as approval.
Approval is action-specific, target-specific and time-bounded.
High-risk actions must not be bundled with routine actions behind one approval.
Permanent deletion must remain unavailable when a safe archive or reversible alternative is feasible.
